final: SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_pt), AVG(avg_ratio) FROM (SELECT L.ID AS ID, P.SEX AS SEX, AVG(L.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(CAST(L.ALP AS REAL) / L.GPT) AS avg_ratio FROM Laboratory L JOIN Patient P ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.ID NOT IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE "U-PRO" = '-' AND ID IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY L.ID, P.SEX) GROUP BY SEX
